articles.title: The Dungeon Crawler Carl TV Series Has Its Showrunners
articles.body:
The Dungeon Crawler Carl TV show has taken a big step forward with Chris Yost and Eric Heisserer being named co-showrunners for the series.

Matt Dinniman's popular LitRPG series was officially confirmed for Peacock earlier this year, but we haven't heard much news about it since then. Yost had already been attached to the project as writer, but the move to co-showrunner is a step up. The addition of Heisserer brings a second helping of sci-fi chops to the series.

Yost has worked on a number of Star Wars and Marvel projects over the years. He acted as a consultant and writer for the first season of The Mandalorian (which IGN gave an 8 out of 10 ) and co-wrote two Thor sequels (The Dark World and Ragnarok). He was also previously showrunner for the Paramount+ series Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles .

Heisserer most recently worked as showrunner for Netflix's Shadow and Bone series, which he also created and produced. You may also recognize him as the writer of Denis Villeneuve's Arrival , which he adapted from Ted Chiang's popular sci-fi novella.

With seasoned sci-fi showrunners at the helm and Seth MacFarlane's Fuzzy Door involved, the Dungeon Crawler Carl series seems like it's being truly set up for success . During San Diego Comic-Con , it was also announced that the narrator of the audiobooks, Jeff Hays, would be reprising his role as the voice of Princess Donut. Dinniman himself praised the decision in an interview with IGN , saying, "He's so associated with that sound and that voice. Anybody else would be jarring."

While we still don't have any sort of release date attached to the series, the momentum created by the Dungeon Crawler Books themselves is likely to continue for years to come. Matt Dinniman still has two books left to write, and there's even a tabletop RPG based on the series releasing in December.

On the streaming side of things, Peacock recently announced its fourth price increase in four years. The increase arrives as the service is adding in YouTube Premium for its subscribers at no extra cost sometime in early 2027.

Jacob Kienlen is a Senior Audience Development Strategist and Writer for IGN. Born and raised in Portland, Oregon, he has considered the Northwest his home for his entire life. With a bachelor's degree in communication and 10 years of professional writing experience, his expertise is spread across a variety of different pop culture topics -- from TV series to books and the latest LEGO sets .

articles.title: Amazon Has Box Set Deals Hidden Deep Within Its BOGO 50% Off Book Sale
articles.body:
Amazon is having a 'buy 2, save 50% on 1' sale on paperback books today. If you're looking to save a bit of cash on a new novel, can check the full list of what's included in the promotion .

There's some great reads in here. You can get the first two paperback Dungeon Crawler Carl books or pick up a copy of Andy Weir's Project Hail Mary at a discount, and that's just scratching the surface of what's available. If you're looking to save as much money as possible, however, I recommend checking out the box sets hidden deep within the sale.

A Court of Thorns and Roses Paperback Box Set

Frank Herbert's Dune Saga 3-Book Boxed Set

Classic King Boxed Set 1: Christine, Cujo, Pet Sematary

Divergent Series Four-Book Paperback Box Set

The box set deals are somewhat limited, but if you're a fan of romantsy books , there are some excellent deals for you here. The paperback box set of Sarah J. Maas' ACOTAR series is heavily discounted already and included here. Maas announced back-to-back new novels for late 2026 and early 2027, so there's never been a better time to get a copy of the first five books. Her already completed Throne of Glass series is also included here as well.

If you find yourself a bit Dune-curious as Dennis Villeneuve's epic conclusion to his Dune trilogy looms, the three-book box set is an easy recommendation. It contains the first three novels in Frank Herbert's series, which is all you need to get caught up before Dune: Part 3 . Technically there are 23 Dune books , but it gets really weird after the third one.

For fans of YA books , there are a couple of solid options here as well. The Hunger Games four-book box set includes all of the books from the series except for Sunrise on the Reaping . With the next movie coming out later this year, it's a good time to dive back into Suzanne Collins' dystopian franchise. You can also get the Divergent box set in the sale if you need even more books like The Hunger Games in your life.

articles.title: Avengers: Doomsday Trailer Gets Frame-by-Frame Official LEGO Remake
articles.summary: Marvel Studios has recreated the Avengers: Doomsday trailer frame-by-frame in LEGO, bringing Doctor Doom and Earth's Mightiest Heroes to life brick-by-brick.
articles.body:
IGN can exclusively reveal an official LEGO-inspired version of the trailer for Marvel Studios’ Avengers: Doomsday .

The trailer – created by Disney Consumer Products, Marvel Studios and LEGO as part of their “All Moments Lead to Doomsday” campaign – can be watched below.

Featuring the voices of the actual Doomsday cast, including Robert Downey Jr. as Doctor Doom , the trailer is a shot-for-shot, beat-for-beat recreation of the live-action trailer released in July but in LEGO form, as seen in the side-by-side comparison embedded below.

"The LEGO brick-built trailer is a nod to the creativity of the Marvel fandom and builds excitement for Marvel Studios' Avengers: Doomsday theatrical release," said Paul Gitter, Executive Vice President, Global Brand Commercialization, Disney Consumer Products.

"By bringing together the power of our storytelling and consumer products expertise with world-class licensing relationships, we're able to create innovative fan experiences that extend our stories beyond the screen in ways that are unique to only Disney."

The first live-action Avengers: Doomsday trailer has garnered over 67 million views on Marvel’s YouTube channel.

With Doomsday opening in theaters on December 18 – opposite Dune: Part 3 – we’re beginning to glean a few more details about the Russo Brothers-directed film as we inch closer to release.

There’s David Harbour apparently dropping a huge spoiler , Sebastian Stan admitting he knows next to nothing about the story , fan theories about there actually being two Doctor Dooms , and the news about how Marvel’s San Diego Comic-Con ads cost them $160,000 in fines .

Meanwhile, Chris Evans has opened up about the lengths Marvel went to keep his return as Steve Rogers secret and how Doomsday will be “brutal” for the former Captain America .

But before Doomsday gets here, fans will first be treated to a theatrical re-release of Avengers: Endgame that features four minutes of brand new footage, which officially makes it the longest MCU movie of all time .

articles.title: The Witcher 4 Confirmed for 2028 Release in Official CD Projekt Gamescom 2026 Announcement
articles.summary: The Witcher 4 is targeting a 2028 release window, CD Projekt has confirmed.
articles.body:
The Witcher 4 is targeting a 2028 release window, CD Projekt has confirmed.

The announcement comes via a special video message from Michał Nowakowski, Joint Chief Executive Officer, CD Projekt Red. Assuming CD Projekt hits 2028 for The Witcher 4, and the company sticks to its ambitious release strategy for this new The Witcher trilogy , we could see The Witcher 5 in 2031 and The Witcher 6 in 2034.

Nowakowski said CD Projekt will show off The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt expansion Songs of the Past at gamescom this week, including "a taste of its dark story" and the new content.

Every CD Projekt Red Game In Development

Eslewhere, Nowakowski confirmed The Witcher 4 will not be at gamescom 2026. "Our team here at CD Projekt Red HQ is hard at work on a brand new saga, one with Siri at the helm. We have more than 500 incredibly talented developers working to create something truly special for you. The Witcher 4 features a huge and immersive open world, intense and action-packed gameplay, and a deep, impactful story that we hope will stay with you for a long time. Simply put, this is our biggest, boldest, and most ambitious game to date.

"Now I know you're eager to learn when it's coming. That's the question we're hearing from you all the time. So while we're not showing The Witcher 4 at the event, and we're not ready to share an exact date, I can tell you this: The Witcher 4 is targeting a 2028 release window.

"I know it's a bit of a wait and you'd love to play it sooner, but let the team cook. It will be worth the wait. Until then, there will be plenty more of The Witcher to come, including Songs of the Past when it launches in 2027. And you can be sure gamescom is also in our plans for the coming years."

Songs of the Past is the third expansion for CD Projekt’s fantasy masterpiece, and is due out 12 years after the original game came out and 11 years after the much-loved second expansion, Blood and Wine. CD Projekt is co-developing the expansion with Fool’s Theory, a team comprising "industry veterans" who worked on The Witcher 3. Here’s what we know so far.

The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Songs of the Past first details:

Songs of the Past is the third expansion for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt

It will launch in 2027 on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC

CD Projekt Red is co-developing Songs of the Past with Fool’s Theory

Songs of the Past will return players to the role of legendary monster slayer Geralt of Rivia for a brand new adventure when it launches in 2027 on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC.

CD Projekt has suggested Songs of the Past will help set the stage for The Witcher 4 . While telling a standalone story starring Geralt set after the events of The Witcher 3, the new adventure will also act as a prologue of sorts to The Witcher 4.

Speaking to investors in May, Nowakowski was questioned on how the expansion is being positioned in the franchise, why it will launch in 2027 after previously being expected this year, and whether any of CD Projekt's new trilogy of The Witcher games will also receive expansions, as The Witcher 3 has.

"First and foremost, we really wanted to deliver a great experience to the fans, a really cool expansion that's going to make people happy that they can come back to The Witcher 3 setting," Nowakowski said, discussing why Songs of the Past was being made in the first place.

"Of course, indirectly, yes, it is a reminder [of the franchise for fans]. It is, in a way, a prologue, although it's not a prologue in a verbatim way of [being] a prologue for the actual The Witcher 4. Yes, you can look at it as it's a way to maintain certain chatter on The Witcher 3. All of those are side effects, additional side effects. The core thing for us, from our perspective, is really delivering a high-quality, fun experience to the existing fans of The Witcher."

"We had a moment where our plans assumed that Songs of the Past would be released this year," Nowakowski said, when questioned why the expansion was launching later than expected. "We decided together with the development team, that the game will be launching in 2027, to be honest, to achieve the best possible result from the consumer standpoint, which in the end, frankly speaking, is the only ultimate thing that really matters."

During a livestream aimed at The Witcher fans, CD Projekt gave a few further hints on the expansion's focus, teasing the importance of Geralt's new third sword — as glimpsed in a recent piece of artwork released to celebrate a springtime festival. Geralt's bard buddy Dandelion is also present.

"We won't give too much away right now because we want you to experience it as you play," senior community and social media manager Laura Beitzel teased during the 10th anniversary livestream designed to celebrate Blood and Wine.

"But as a few eagle-eyed people have already seen over the past 24 hours, there are some hints waiting for you on a very important evening in Witcher lore, Belleteyn Night, in our Belleteyn celebration that we shared a few weeks ago. So... keep looking for clues."

Here, Beitzel is referencing a piece of artwork and a poem it posted on social media in April. It shows Geralt resting by a bonfire as Dandelion plays the lute while villagers dance. More importantly, though, it shows Geralt with a mysterious new sword — the same sword he's also holding in Songs of the Past's reveal artwork, which sports an unusual ornate curved crossguard.

"So yes, Geralt is holding a sword," CD Projekt's Amelia Korzycka continued, referencing Songs of the Past's key artwork. "It is a very important sword for the story and you will get to know it when the game comes out. So a few more streams before that when [we] reveal it."

We also have confirmation that Songs of the Past will include more Gwent cards, and that CD Projekt was still working on cross-platform mod support for The Witcher 3, to launch at some point in the future.

CD Projekt has yet to show Songs of the Past off in any way since it announced the expansion in May , so I expect we’ll see a trailer and, hopefully, some gameplay at ONL on August 25. The show kicks off at 11am PT / 2pm ET / 7pm UK time / 8pm CEST.

The Witcher 3 recently hit an astonishing 65 million copies sold (it only seemed right that The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim hit the same sales milestone just a few months later ).

paragraphs: The Witcher 4 is targeting a 2028 release window, CD Projekt has confirmed.

The announcement comes via a special video message from Michał Nowakowski, Joint Chief Executive Officer, CD Projekt Red. Nowakowski said CD Projekt will show off The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt expansion Songs of the Past at gamescom this week, including "a taste of its dark story" and the new content.
Every CD Projekt Red Game In Development

Eslewhere, Nowakowski confirmed The Witcher 4 will not be at gamescom 2026. "Our team here at CD Projekt Red HQ is hard at work on a brand new saga, one with Siri at the helm. We have more than 500 incredibly talented developers working to create something truly special for you. The Witcher 4 features a huge and immersive open world, intense and action-packed gameplay, and a deep, impactful story that we hope will stay with you for a long time. articles.title: The Folio Society Reveals The Three-Body Problem Trilogy: Remembrance of Earth's Past
articles.summary: If you can stomach the price, The Folio Society's gorgeous hardcover The Three-Body Problem Trilogy: Remembrance of Earth's Past is the ultimate collectible for fans of Liu Cixin's sci-fi epic.
articles.body:
Liu Cixin's The Three-Body Problem trilogy is widely regarded as one of the best science fiction epics of the modern era, and that story has reached an even wider audience lately thanks to the Netflix series. If you're a fan of the books and want to own them in the finest version possible, then you'll be pleased to know that The Folio Society is releasing a lavish new hardcover called The Three-Body Problem Trilogy: Remembrance of Earth's Past.

IGN can exclusively debut some of Matt Griffin's stunning artwork featured inside this illustrated hardcover. Get a closer look in the slideshow gallery below:

The Folio Society's The Three-Body Problem Trilogy: Remembrance of Earth's Past - Preview Gallery

The Three-Body Problem Trilogy: Remembrance of Earth's Past collects all three books in the series - The Three-Body Problem, The Dark Forest, and Death's End. The book features art and design work by Griffin and includes a brand-new introduction by the author never before published in English.

The Folio Society's official description teases:

The 1344-page limited edition will feature a special box design, lining, frontispiece, cover design, as well as 3 black & white integrated title-page spreads (one for each book in the trilogy), and 15 color illustrations including 3 double page spreads, all by the award-winning illustrator Matt Griffin. Bound in printed cloth with a design by Matt Griffin and blocked lettering by Steve O Connell, the limited edition also features blocked endpapers on Sirio Color Dark Blue paper, a ribbon marker, printed book edges, an outer Clamshell covered in holographic blocked cloth, and a copper holographic blocked paper lining. The lining features real three-body simulations created by Matt Griffin using a program from MIT which he received special permission to use.

“Starting with the Chinese Cultural Revolution and spanning some 18 million years into the future, Liu Cixin's masterpiece is as broad as it is compelling,” said Folio Society Editor James Rose in a statement. “A tale of humanity's struggle, and that of a civilisation fighting for its very existence, this dares to answer the question: 'Are we alone in the Universe?'. Beautifully and brilliant evoked in Matt Griffin's artwork, this is the ultimate edition of a science-fiction phenomenon. Fans of the series, anyone interested in sci-fi and hard science, and new readers alike will be awestruck by this edition.”

The Three-Body Problem Trilogy: Remembrance of Earth's Past is priced at £550 / US $780 and will be available to preorder beginning on September 8 on the Folio Society website .

In IGN's 3 Body Problem review , Jordan Hoffman writes, "3 Body Problem reworks Cixin Liu’s mammoth book trilogy for a wider audience to great success, though it may annoy some viewers with its far-out sci-fi and speed-of-light plot machinations. Some sequences work better than others – like the video game side story delivering a soupçon of cringe – but many of the performances and one shocking sequence make for a more-than-worthy adaption of the beloved franchise."

Jesse is a mild-mannered staff writer for IGN. Allow him to lend a machete to your intellectual thicket by following @jschedeen on BlueSky .

articles.title: Lanterns Fans Say Episode 2 Is Hiding a Classic Green Lantern Villain in Plain Sight
articles.summary: Lanterns Episode 2 is here, and fans believe it's hiding a vicious Green Lantern villain in plain sight.
articles.body:
Lanterns Episode 2 is here, and fans believe it's hiding a vicious Green Lantern villain in plain sight.

Warning! Lanterns Season 1 Episode 2 spoilers follow.

There's some extraterrestrial activity in Rushville, Nebraska, and Hal Jordan (Kyle Chandler) is determined to get to the bottom of it. While he's off constructing a plan to get dead bodies out of the morgue and through town, John Stewart (Aaron Pierre) is sent on a fetch quest to bring back a big green battery and keep his little bird safe. The Green Lantern-in-training doesn't make it too far before he's ambushed and kidnapped for a quick chat about what is said to be a new threat to Earth: Manhunters.

It's here viewers run into Paul Ben-Victor's Antaan, the leader of a group of aliens looking to root out a Manhunter who's believed to be taking shelter in Rushville. He's threatened to level the town if John isn't able to unmask the Manhunter within 48 hours, but some fans suspect we've already encountered one of the most infamous supervillains the Green Lantern Corps has ever known.

Antaan is definitely Atrocitus. The vibe I get from him just makes me think that’s who he actually is. pic.twitter.com/acPYDlFmmB — DC Universe Daily (@DCdaily) August 24, 2026

Antaan is definitely Atrocitus. The vibe I get from him just makes me think that’s who he actually is. pic.twitter.com/acPYDlFmmB

During his meeting with John, Antaan says the Manhunters are responsible for wiping out his people, going as far as to forcibly project their supposed atrocities into John's mind. It just so happens that backstory shares a few things in common with the Red Lanterns and their angry alien bad guy, Atrocitus.

Past incarnations of the Red Lantern are also known to have suffered at the hands of the Manhunters, and with fans looking for Antaan's other connections to the DC universe, Atrocitus is who is making the most sense. Where Green Lanterns use will to build their Constructs and Yellow Lanterns use fear, Red Lanterns are driven by their rage, potentially presenting a vengeful entity for Hal and John to deal with as Lanterns progresses.

Considering Atrocitus typically looks bigger and meaner than Ben-Victor's character, these loosely connected dots might not have you convinced another classic DC villain will be joining Sinestro in this latest jump to the live-action DCU. However, fans aren't letting up.

yeah this guy’s definitely Atrocitus https://t.co/lGYEtv8ej8 — Drew ꗞ (@GoodNightDrew) August 24, 2026

yeah this guy’s definitely Atrocitus https://t.co/lGYEtv8ej8

This mf is defo Atrocitus pic.twitter.com/qz6f61ESON — Charlie 🐧 (@CharliePengMoji) August 24, 2026

This mf is defo Atrocitus pic.twitter.com/qz6f61ESON

SE PREPAREM PQ O VILÃO MAIS FODA DO LANTERNA VERDE VULGO ATROCITUS ESTÁ CHEGANDO #Lanterns pic.twitter.com/NKQCuq4Cli — O Gui 🍐! dcnauta orgulhoso (@Birdsofpera) August 24, 2026

SE PREPAREM PQ O VILÃO MAIS FODA DO LANTERNA VERDE VULGO ATROCITUS ESTÁ CHEGANDO #Lanterns pic.twitter.com/NKQCuq4Cli

When Deadline first reported that Ben-Victor would be joining the Green Lantern show, it described his character as "an extraterrestrial devoted to exposing the truth and exacting vengeance against those who wronged his people. Consumed by a deep and unrelenting hatred for the law, he is determined to deliver justice on his own terms."

That certainly sounds a bit more like the Atrocitus we know from the comics. When you consider that Lanterns has already established its world as one populated by aliens who can conceal their identities, it's not outside of the realm of possibility that the Red Lantern leader might have a mask of his own.

Meanwhile, Episode 2 isn't the first time Atrocitus theories have popped up online. Last week, user 'I_warisha,' for example, took to Reddit to draw connections between major events happening in years ending with the number six and Sector 666. It seemed like more of a reach at the time, but as the pieces come together, it wind up being a sneaky Easter Egg for what's to come.

"Probably Atrocitus and the massacre he referred to was probably the Massacre of Sector 666," another fan online suggested .

"There's just no way Paul Ben-Victor's character isn't Atrocitus," another theorized . "In the comics the manhunters are the ones who wiped out Atrocitus' planet including his family. The way he's speaking about it here perfectly lines up with that, and like he was there to see it, too."

As Lanterns is just taking off , it's hard to say just how many fan-favorite characters it will pull into the DC in its first season. For now, all we know about the rest of the story is that it certainly seems like Hal Jordan will meet an untimely demise at some point before all eight episodes are up. John Stewart, at least, seems headed for a bright future in the DCU, as Pierre is already confirmed to show up in Superman sequel Man of Tomorrow .

While we wait for Episode 3 to arrive this Sunday, you can check out IGN's review and recap for Episode 2 , and you can see what showrunner Chris Mundy had to say about it , too. For more, be sure to see how DC Studios co-CEO defended the evolving tone of the DCU .

Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. He's best known for his work at sites like The Pitch, The Escapist, and OnlySP. Be sure to give him a follow on Bluesky (@mikecripe.bsky.social) and Twitter (@MikeCripe).

articles.title: Lanterns Episode 3 Teaser Reveals First Look at Hal Jordan Wearing Iconic Green Lantern Domino Mask
articles.summary: HBO has published the first teaser for Lanterns Episode 3, and it comes with a first look at Hal Jordan wearing Green Lantern's iconic domino mask.
articles.body:
HBO has published the first teaser for Lanterns Episode 3, and it comes with a first look at Hal Jordan wearing Green Lantern's iconic domino mask.

The network dropped the latest trailer for its DCU show following the conclusion of Episode 2 last night. If you didn't catch it after the credits rolled, the full 42-second Lanterns teaser can now be found on the HBO Max YouTube channel .

Don't worry; it doesn't give away too much. As has already been teased, John Stewart (Aaron Pierre) is being set up to be a special part of the DCU as episodes roll out. That means confronting what seems to be a Guardian (played by Laura Linney) and reckoning with his past. If the Lanterns Episode 3 teaser is anything to go by, the Green Lantern-in-training seems to be the star of next week's episode, but the moment that has everyone talking online actually concerns a blink-and-you'll-miss-it moment featuring Hal Jordan (Kyle Chandler).

John Stewart was born for this. Watch new episodes of #Lanterns on Sundays at 9pm on HBO Max. pic.twitter.com/9SMnO7rINT — HBO Max (@hbomax) August 24, 2026

John Stewart was born for this. Watch new episodes of #Lanterns on Sundays at 9pm on HBO Max. pic.twitter.com/9SMnO7rINT

Just after the 17-second mark, you can see a few frames from an old TV playing what seems to be footage of the news covering Hal Jordan. He appears to be suited up in the same outfit we've seen Chandler wear in the show itself, but the main difference here is his bright-green domino mask.

So far, Chandler has given DC fans a slightly grumpier version of the Green Lantern they might be used to. While he's generally been hailed as a fitting inclusion for the DCU, connecting his character to the one we've seen featured in comic books and animated projects for decades has been a bit difficult for some. Seeing him suited up in full Green Lantern Corps attire seems to have already helped connect those dots for those fans online.

Warning! Spoilers for Lanterns Season 1 Episodes 1 and 2 follow.

All of that said, this may be a little more than an Easter Egg rather than a sneak peek at what this particular costume will eventually look like in motion. For starters, the end of Episode 1 pretty heavily implied that Hal Jordan's days in the DCU are already numbered . The Episode 3 teaser also suggested that we'll be skipping around the timeline yet again, potentially traveling back to 1996. If we do see Hal Jordan sporting his domino mask, those moments may be limited to a few flashback sequences.

New look at Hal Jordan wearing a domino mask in 'LANTERNS'. pic.twitter.com/d20PWHm6II — DC Film News (@DCFilmNews) August 24, 2026

New look at Hal Jordan wearing a domino mask in 'LANTERNS'. pic.twitter.com/d20PWHm6II

MASKED HAL JORDAN YOOOOO #Lanterns pic.twitter.com/R61q87Psp2 — Axel🦇 (@AxelTalksFilm) August 24, 2026

MASKED HAL JORDAN YOOOOO #Lanterns pic.twitter.com/R61q87Psp2

OMG the concept of having to wait another week pic.twitter.com/yOcGKss712 — stuff (@stuffiseeonline) August 24, 2026

OMG the concept of having to wait another week pic.twitter.com/yOcGKss712

Still, it's easy to see why fans might be excited for such a relatively small development. The last time we saw a live-action Hal Jordan wearing the mask was when Ryan Reynolds played the character for his 2011 standalone movie, and we all know how that went.

As the DCU comes together, moments like these can be just as important as the projects themselves. Fans clamored for a first look at Robert Pattinson as Batman and again flocked to see him throw on the cowl for The Batman Part 2 . David Corenswet's Superman drew eyes when his costume was revealed back in 2024 .

As Hal Jordan seemingly winds down his time as a Green Lantern, we've yet to see what Pierre's John Stewart looks like in the suit. We'll hopefully get a better look when he reprises his role for the DCU's Superman sequel, Man of Tomorrow , next year.

While we wait for Lanterns Episode 3 this weekend, August 30, you can see what IGN thought of Episode 2 . You can also learn about the villain some viewers think is hiding in plain sight , as well as what DC Studios co-CEO James Gunn had to say about the gritty tone for the new DCU series .

Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. He's best known for his work at sites like The Pitch, The Escapist, and OnlySP. Be sure to give him a follow on Bluesky (@mikecripe.bsky.social) and Twitter (@MikeCripe).

If the Lanterns Episode 3 teaser is anything to go by, the Green Lantern-in-training seems to be the star of next week's episode, but the moment that has everyone talking online actually concerns a blink-and-you'll-miss-it moment featuring Hal Jordan (Kyle Chandler).
John Stewart was born for this. Watch new episodes of #Lanterns on Sundays at 9pm on HBO Max. pic.twitter.com/9SMnO7rINT — HBO Max (@hbomax) August 24, 2026
John Stewart was born for this. Watch new episodes of #Lanterns on Sundays at 9pm on HBO Max. pic.twitter.com/9SMnO7rINT

Just after the 17-second mark, you can see a few frames from an old TV playing what seems to be footage of the news covering Hal Jordan. He appears to be suited up in the same outfit we've seen Chandler wear in the show itself, but the main difference here is his bright-green domino mask.

So far, Chandler has given DC fans a slightly grumpier version of the Green Lantern they might be used to. While he's generally been hailed as a fitting inclusion for the DCU, connecting his character to the one we've seen featured in comic books and animated projects for decades has been a bit difficult for some. Seeing him suited up in full Green Lantern Corps attire seems to have already helped connect those dots for those fans online.
Warning! Spoilers for Lanterns Season 1 Episodes 1 and 2 follow.

All of that said, this may be a little more than an Easter Egg rather than a sneak peek at what this particular costume will eventually look like in motion. For starters, the end of Episode 1 pretty heavily implied that Hal Jordan's days in the DCU are already numbered . The Episode 3 teaser also suggested that we'll be skipping around the timeline yet again, potentially traveling back to 1996. If we do see Hal Jordan sporting his domino mask, those moments may be limited to a few flashback sequences.
New look at Hal Jordan wearing a domino mask in 'LANTERNS'. pic.twitter.com/d20PWHm6II — DC Film News (@DCFilmNews) August 24, 2026
New look at Hal Jordan wearing a domino mask in 'LANTERNS'. pic.twitter.com/d20PWHm6II
MASKED HAL JORDAN YOOOOO #Lanterns pic.twitter.com/R61q87Psp2 — Axel🦇 (@AxelTalksFilm) August 24, 2026
MASKED HAL JORDAN YOOOOO #Lanterns pic.twitter.com/R61q87Psp2
OMG the concept of having to wait another week pic.twitter.com/yOcGKss712 — stuff (@stuffiseeonline) August 24, 2026
OMG the concept of having to wait another week pic.twitter.com/yOcGKss712

Still, it's easy to see why fans might be excited for such a relatively small development. The last time we saw a live-action Hal Jordan wearing the mask was when Ryan Reynolds played the character for his 2011 standalone movie, and we all know how that went.

As the DCU comes together, moments like these can be just as important as the projects themselves. Fans clamored for a first look at Robert Pattinson as Batman and again flocked to see him throw on the cowl for The Batman Part 2 . David Corenswet's Superman drew eyes when his costume was revealed back in 2024 .

As Hal Jordan seemingly winds down his time as a Green Lantern, we've yet to see what Pierre's John Stewart looks like in the suit. We'll hopefully get a better look when he reprises his role for the DCU's Superman sequel, Man of Tomorrow , next year.

While we wait for Lanterns Episode 3 this weekend, August 30, you can see what IGN thought of Episode 2 . You can also learn about the villain some viewers think is hiding in plain sight , as well as what DC Studios co-CEO James Gunn had to say about the gritty tone for the new DCU series .

articles.title: France and Saudi Arabia to Build $7 Billion Dragon Ball Z Theme Park Outside Paris
articles.summary: France and Saudi Arabia have come to the mutual conclusion that the world needs Dragon Ball Z theme park. So, they’re building one near Paris to the tune of €6 billion ($7 billion USD).
articles.body:
France and Saudi Arabia have come to the mutual conclusion that the world needs Dragon Ball Z theme park. So, they’re building one near Paris to the tune of €6 billion ($7 billion USD).

The Elysee Palace announced the news on Monday, August 23, during the Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman’s visit to Paris. The idea was reportedly first sparked during the Crown Prince’s trip to the city last year, when he and French President Emmanuel Macron discovered their shared love for the iconic anime franchise.

The park will be constructed northwest of the capital city near Cergy-Pontoise, with the massive project expected to create approximately 22,000 jobs. Construction is predicted to take several years, with no opening date publicly announced as yet.

To no one’s surprise, Qiddiya is providing the funds for the project, which will be one of two Dragon Ball Z theme parks once all is said and done. The first theme park was officially revealed on the official Dragon Ball website back in 2024, along with extensive concept art and teasers for what it’ll look like when construction is complete.

The first park is currently being built in Qiddiya City, a massive entertainment hub currently in development just outside the capital of Riyadh. It will reportedly span more than 500,000 square meters, featuring seven recreations of locales from the series including the Kame House, Capsule Corporation, and Beerus's Planet.

Five rides will also be included as part of a 30+ attraction total, along with a 70-meter-tall statue of Shenron. It’s a massive undertaking, and one that isn’t expected to open anytime soon, with no official opening date released at the time of writing.

Dragon Ball Z Theme Park Concept Art (2024)

The announcement of Paris’s Dragon Ball theme park comes after the Esports World Cup was relocated to the city due to security concerns near Riyadh, where it was previously scheduled to take place. Saudi Arabia’s Crown Prince was in attendance for the competition’s closing ceremony, where Macron was also present.

This is one of several expansive investments the country has made into cultural projects within the gaming and anime space; most recently, Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund completed a $55 billion acquisition of EA as part of an investor group alongside Silver Lake and Affinity Partners.

In March, Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed Bin Salman's Electronic Gaming Development Company (EGDC) acquired a 5% stake in Capcom, upping its ownership in the famed Japanese game developer and publisher to 10%.

And back in February, Saudi-owned RTS took full ownership of Evo , the world’s largest fighting game tournament series, which has since expanded to include several other global Evo events in a controversial turn of events within the fighting game community.

Virginia (she/her) is IGN’s News Editor. With ten years of experience reporting on games and entertainment, she’s got a storied background in the fighting game community, influencer news, and viral online trends. Find her on Twitter at @TheeMissGlaze .

articles.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Devs Vow to Update Captain Price After Botched Haircut Goes Viral
articles.summary: Publisher Activision and developer Infinity Ward have promised to update Captain Price's hair in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 after images of his botched haircut went viral.
articles.body:
Publisher Activision and developer Infinity Ward have promised to update Captain Price's hair in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 after images of his botched haircut went viral.

As last weekend's closed beta dredged up conversations revolving around its time-to-kill (TTK) speeds and problematic spawn placements, other fans aimed at Captain Price and his barber. It's mostly thanks to a few images that have circulated across social media, with fans pointing out that, maybe, Modern Warfare 4's version of the classic character should invest in some hair gel.

He looks…unwell, at least when compared to past versions of Captain Price. Whether he's chasing down Vladimir Makarov or walking you through a training course, Price is known to have a full head of hair and a beard that could make even Ghost blush. The one from Modern Warfare 4, however, has neither of those things, and according to many, he hardly looks like the Task Force 141 leader fans have come to know. Activision and Infinity Ward say that's not their intention, but there's also a good reason why only some Call of Duty fans are encountering this choppy imposter.

bro.... https://t.co/JxOTxMTny3 pic.twitter.com/WQEHOTgdEU — innerghost (@innerghost_) August 23, 2026

bro.... https://t.co/JxOTxMTny3 pic.twitter.com/WQEHOTgdEU

that ain't captain Price that's lieutenant Cost https://t.co/gtAFT18NhF — narancia gaming (@naranciagaming) August 24, 2026

that ain't captain Price that's lieutenant Cost https://t.co/gtAFT18NhF

That ain’t price that’s amount — IPhantom369 (@CJerome369) August 23, 2026

While the Captain Price making the rounds online does appear to be real, he'll only look this way in Modern Warfare 4 if users tune their devices to the lowest possible settings. Some had expected this to be the case, as reports of the botched haircut seemed to mostly be few and far between.

Still, the developers and Activision and Infinity Ward are going to do their best to give the Call of Duty fan-favorite Operator the head of hair he deserves. The studio community teams X/Twitter account replied to a few of the more popular posts, promising it would be addressed "in a future update."

"Captain Price's hair does not appear correctly when viewing his character model at the lowest level of detail," a tab in the "Known Issues" column from the Modern Warfare 4 Trello says.

Hello! We're aware of an issue with Price's hair not appearing correctly when viewed at the lowest level of detail. The team will be addressing it in a future update. Ultimately this will not be an issue if players meet our recommended specs. Details: https://t.co/uozRRLS3W5 — CallofDutyCM (@CallofDutyCM) August 24, 2026

Hello! We're aware of an issue with Price's hair not appearing correctly when viewed at the lowest level of detail. The team will be addressing it in a future update. Ultimately this will not be an issue if players meet our recommended specs. Details: https://t.co/uozRRLS3W5

What in the 1050 TI is this? Whoever took that screenshot got the game at ultra low, ultra performance, 11% resolution. pic.twitter.com/Pq3A5BdzFt — The Natty One (@lunatty787) August 23, 2026

What in the 1050 TI is this? Whoever took that screenshot got the game at ultra low, ultra performance, 11% resolution. pic.twitter.com/Pq3A5BdzFt

What exactly that update entails remains to be seen, but it's far from the only thing on the team's list. Also noted in the Known Issues category are dropped framerates when cooking lethal weapons, hitches for PC players during their first multiplayer matches, a stuck loadout screen bug, and more. TTK is another issue the team is looking into , as are those spawns.

So, if you find yourself dissatisfied with the Modern Warfare 4 beta, you might want to take another crack at it when the open beta launches this weekend . You can learn more about everything it comes with, including its single-player mission, here .

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 has a release date of October 23, 2026, for PC, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X | S. For more, you can read about how it will allow players to remove masks for some of its Operators . You can also check out IGN's interview with the team to learn about Infinity Ward's approach to matchmaking, the beta, and more.

articles.title: The Witcher 3 Songs of the Past Expansion Confirmed to Include More Gwent, and Everyone Is Already Celebrating
articles.summary: CD Projekt Red has confirmed The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt's upcoming Songs of the Past expansion will come with more Gwent, and card game lovers are already celebrating.
articles.body:
CD Projekt Red has confirmed The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt 's upcoming Songs of the Past expansion will come with more Gwent, and card game lovers are already celebrating.

The Witcher 3 earned a lot of praise when it launched back in 2015. While Doug Cockle 's gravelly delivery as Geralt helped sell its story, and its RPG gameplay quickly hooked in every kind of fantasy fan, many would say Gwent was what truly kept them coming back for more.

"In Gwent, gamers clash with friends in fast-paced duels that combine skill-based play with bluffing, and careful deck construction," an official description from CD Projekt Red says . "The game is played over a best-of-three series of rounds, as players unleash their hand by slinging spells and diverse units with special abilities, and use clever tricks to deceive their opponents."

CD Projekt Red's in-universe card game first launched within the third installment in its Witcher series before being transformed into a standalone spinoff in 2017 and a real-life tabletop experience in 2025. It's a formula others have unsuccessfully attempted to mimic, but few have managed to stand the test of time quite like Gwent. That's probably exactly why it will be making a comeback when the developer returns to The Witcher 3 with its Songs of the Past expansion in 2027.

CD Projekt Red community and social media manager Marcin Łukaszewski teased the return of the fan-favorite side activity when replying to a player on X/Twitter . When the fan said they hoped more Gwent would be included in the surprise expansion, Łukaszewski offered a simple reply: "Confirmed!"

It's been more than 10 years since The Witcher 3's last expansion, Blood and Wine, came out in 2016, and by the time Songs of the Past launches next year, that wait will have been even longer. CD Projekt Red has teased that this is a full-fledged add-on for the game's story, teasing earlier this year that it will serve as a prologue . In other words, don't expect it to be all Gwent all the time, but for those who have waited to sit down for another round of tabletop challenges, it sounds like there's already more than enough reason to be excited.

pic.twitter.com/o2LfgVq2ih — Brad (@definitelybrad_) August 23, 2026

Well, I hope whatever the main plot of Songs of the Past is, it’s not urgent. Because Geralt’s got more Gwenting to do, baby! #Witcher3 https://t.co/IT8PwXY6lZ pic.twitter.com/10vnDoF1gR — Michał Novigrad (@MichalNovigrad) August 23, 2026

Well, I hope whatever the main plot of Songs of the Past is, it’s not urgent. Because Geralt’s got more Gwenting to do, baby! #Witcher3 https://t.co/IT8PwXY6lZ pic.twitter.com/10vnDoF1gR

Let's gooooooo!!!!!!!😁⚔️🐺 https://t.co/6xXJ8JoiXt pic.twitter.com/yhylyC1oZw — Merchant of Novigrad🐺⚔️ (@MofNovigrad) August 23, 2026

Let's gooooooo!!!!!!!😁⚔️🐺 https://t.co/6xXJ8JoiXt pic.twitter.com/yhylyC1oZw

IGN called The Witcher 3 "Amazing" in our original 9.3/10 review . We said, "Massive in size, and meticulously detailed, The Witcher 3 ends Geralt's story on a high note." There's plenty more monster hunting to be had as far as CD Projekt Red is concerned, as just earlier today, the studio confirmed The Witcher 4 is on track to launch sometime in 2028 .

As for Songs of the Past, we already know that it won't be much longer before we hear more. In fact, news on the expansion is less than 24 hours away, as the developers have already made plans to share more about it during gamescom 2026 Opening Night Live . While we wait to see what's up CD Projekt Red's sleeve, you can read about The Witcher 3 NPCs who just couldn't stop dropping their babies .

articles.title: Lenovo confirms Legion Go issues after gamers report bricked devices
articles.summary: ﻿I installed Lenovo’s forbidden BIOS and my Legion Go lived. You might be less lucky.
articles.body: When a company’s software update turns your computer into a useless brick, should fixes be free? Framework, the modular computer startup, apparently thinks so. But it’s not clear that computing giant Lenovo will go that far. Three weeks after a Redditor presented a nearly $300 repair bill for their handheld gaming PC — among other reports of damage and high repair bills — the company is breaking its silence. It says, in short: try holding down the power button longer, and if that fails, contact customer support. Here’s the statement Lenovo provided to The Verge, via communications director Jeff Witt: > Lenovo is aware that some Legion Go devices may experience a blank screen during installation of BIOS version V42. BIOS V42 was not distributed through Windows Update or Legion Space, and Lenovo has removed the update from its support website while we continue our validation work. Users who have successfully completed the V42 update should not need to take further action at this time. > If a device encounters a blank screen during V42 installation, users may try pressing and holding the power button for approximately 10 seconds, waiting approximately one minute, and then powering the device on again. If the device does not resume normal operation, customers should contact Lenovo Support for further assistance. > Lenovo continues to evaluate and validate future BIOS updates for Legion Go. On the official Lenovo forums, it appears another Lenovo employee may have weighed in, too: a “Daniel_Legion” claims the issue “should be repaired free of charge” if you’re under warranty. “In the case of out-of-warranty devices, it should be repaired free of charge, but please check local laws,” they write. [Image: The Lenovo forum topic where Daniel_Legion weighs in. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/chrome_jRP4X1wMCS.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] But Daniel_Legion has no other visible posts on the Lenovo forums, and “we’ll repair it if local laws force us to” isn’t a particularly reassuring pitch, so we’re asking Lenovo to confirm his words and their meaning. Will Lenovo extend its warranty to cover bad BIOS bricks? It’s important to note that not every Legion Go was vulnerable to begin with. You’d need to have the original Legion Go 8APU1, not the Legion Go S or the Legion Go 2, and you would’ve had to download BIOS V42 (N3CN42WW) directly from the company’s website over the two or so months before Lenovo yanked it. Even then, you might have been safe. The other day, I chose violence and decided to install the forbidden BIOS V42 on my own Legion Go review unit, and… after a long, scary sequence of black screens and progress bars and warnings and more black screens that lasted six whole minutes, it booted up just fine. (Plays games, even lets me log into Windows by typing my PIN with the gamepad controls. I couldn’t do that right before the update.) [Image: BIOS V42 running fine on my Legion Go. Plays games and everything. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/verge-legion-go-sean-hollister-1.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] Assuming Daniel_Legion is legit, it sounds like the investigation is still ongoing. A team in Europe was able to reproduce the issue with three out of three devices tested, but other teams weren’t able to see it at all, he told the Lenovo forums. “As such the issue is most likely related to specific component used on mainboards in certain batch or batches, or the issue needs to have specific circumstances to manifest,” he wrote. I strongly feel that a company shouldn’t need to fully investigate before reassuring customers. They should say “if we did it, we will fix it, even outside of warranty.” That’s what Framework did with its device-bricking BIOS update.
paragraphs: When a company’s software update turns your computer into a useless brick, should fixes be free? Framework, the modular computer startup, apparently thinks so. But it’s not clear that computing giant Lenovo will go that far. Three weeks after a Redditor presented a nearly $300 repair bill for their handheld gaming PC — among other reports of damage and high repair bills — the company is breaking its silence. It says, in short: try holding down the power button longer, and if that fails, contact customer support. Here’s the statement Lenovo provided to The Verge, via communications director Jeff Witt: > Lenovo is aware that some Legion Go devices may experience a blank screen during installation of BIOS version V42. BIOS V42 was not distributed through Windows Update or Legion Space, and Lenovo has removed the update from its support website while we continue our validation work. Users who have successfully completed the V42 update should not need to take further action at this time. > If a device encounters a blank screen during V42 installation, users may try pressing and holding the power button for approximately 10 seconds, waiting approximately one minute, and then powering the device on again. If the device does not resume normal operation, customers should contact Lenovo Support for further assistance. > Lenovo continues to evaluate and validate future BIOS updates for Legion Go. On the official Lenovo forums, it appears another Lenovo employee may have weighed in, too: a “Daniel_Legion” claims the issue “should be repaired free of charge” if you’re under warranty. “In the case of out-of-warranty devices, it should be repaired free of charge, but please check local laws,” they write. [Image: The Lenovo forum topic where Daniel_Legion weighs in. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/chrome_jRP4X1wMCS.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] But Daniel_Legion has no other visible posts on the Lenovo forums, and “we’ll repair it if local laws force us to” isn’t a particularly reassuring pitch, so we’re asking Lenovo to confirm his words and their meaning. Will Lenovo extend its warranty to cover bad BIOS bricks? It’s important to note that not every Legion Go was vulnerable to begin with. You’d need to have the original Legion Go 8APU1, not the Legion Go S or the Legion Go 2, and you would’ve had to download BIOS V42 (N3CN42WW) directly from the company’s website over the two or so months before Lenovo yanked it. Even then, you might have been safe. The other day, I chose violence and decided to install the forbidden BIOS V42 on my own Legion Go review unit, and… after a long, scary sequence of black screens and progress bars and warnings and more black screens that lasted six whole minutes, it booted up just fine. (Plays games, even lets me log into Windows by typing my PIN with the gamepad controls. I couldn’t do that right before the update.) [Image: BIOS V42 running fine on my Legion Go. Plays games and everything. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/verge-legion-go-sean-hollister-1.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] Assuming Daniel_Legion is legit, it sounds like the investigation is still ongoing. A team in Europe was able to reproduce the issue with three out of three devices tested, but other teams weren’t able to see it at all, he told the Lenovo forums. “As such the issue is most likely related to specific component used on mainboards in certain batch or batches, or the issue needs to have specific circumstances to manifest,” he wrote. I strongly feel that a company shouldn’t need to fully investigate before reassuring customers. They should say “if we did it, we will fix it, even outside of warranty.” That’s what Framework did with its device-bricking BIOS update.

articles.title: Batman: Knightfall Part 1 Is Now Available to Watch Online
articles.body:
The latest Batman movie is now available to buy digitally. Knightfall Part 1 is a direct-to-video animated DC movie, but that doesn't mean it isn't an excellent take on the Caped Crusader. We loved it enough to award it an impressive 9 out of 10 in our review .

Batman: Knightfall Part 1 - Knightfall is the start of a new trilogy of animated Batman films. It's based on one of the best Batman graphic novels of all time and is absolutely worth checking out.

Knightfall Part 1 isn't available in theaters, so buying the movie digitally through a VOD service like Prime Video is your only option if you want to watch it right now . If you don't mind waiting until September 8, however, there's a 4K UHD and Blu-ray you can preorder for a bit more money.

As for new live-action Batman movies , you're going to have to wait even longer still. The Batman: Part 2 was pushed back to 2028 and we still don't have a release date for James Gunn's The Brave and the Bold .

articles.title: Asus' Special Gold ROG Xbox Ally X20 Is Surprisingly Affordable – If You Avoid the Bundle
articles.summary: While everything seems to be going up in price lately, due to an ongoing RAMageddon that doesn't seem to be letting up any time soon, Asus' handhelds have somehow avoided the price increases that are hitting everything in the category. And, while the company's special anniversary version of the Xbox Ally X is a bit more expensive than the regular version, it's not by much.
articles.body:
While everything seems to be going up in price lately due to an ongoing RAMageddon that doesn't seem to be letting up any time soon , Asus' handhelds have somehow avoided the price increases that are hitting everything in the category. The company's special anniversary version of the Xbox Ally X is a bit more expensive than the regular version, but it's not by much.

At gamescom , Asus revealed a bit more information about the upcoming gold-themed version of the Xbox Ally X to celebrate ROG's 20th anniversary, called, what else, the Xbox Ally X20. This is essentially the same system as the original Xbox Ally X , just with an OLED display, TMR joysticks, and a fancy new D-pad. Okay, well at least the innards remain the same, with the AMD Ryzen AI Z2 Extreme and 24GB of memory.

Back when Asus announced the X20, I was worried this was going to be a sneaky way to refresh the handheld with a couple new features to raise the price to the same degree as something like the Lenovo Legion Go 2 or the Steam Deck — especially since, back then, it was announced as only part of a bundle with the Asus ROG Xreal R1 glasses I reviewed a few weeks ago.

Luckily, Asus will be releasing the Xbox Ally X20 as a standalone handheld for $1,299, or as a bundle with the glasses for $2,499. That is more expensive than the existing Xbox Ally X, which you can get for about $999 right now. But, that extra $300 might be worth it just for the sake of having an OLED display.

The new handheld looks like it'll take some cues from the Xbox Elite controllers as well. The Xbox Ally X20 will have a transforming D-pad. Basically, you can rotate it to choose between either a concave D-pad or one with four prounounced cardinal directions. Basically, like you're able to do on the Xbox Elite controllers by swapping out the magnetic D-pad.

Of course, the handheld is going to look much fancier than the original. I haven't seen it in person yet, but from Asus' photos, it looks like it has a translucent chassis, with gold accents that really do make it look unique.

The elephant in the room, though, is the bundle. It costs twice as much, and includes the glasses and a few accessories. Everything does look nice, but you're essentially paying an extra $1,200 for a pair of XR glasses that you can buy seperately for $849 – and those were already overpriced. It's going to carry some weight for ROG faithfuls, but the standalone handheld is where it's at. The Xbox Ally X is one of the best Windows handhelds out there, and tacking on an OLED display really might be worth the extra $300, especially with every other handheld with similar specs being closer to $2,000 right now.

Jackie Thomas is the Hardware and Buying Guides Editor at IGN and the PC components queen. You can follow her @Jackiecobra

articles.title: KFC Reveals the Oreo Chicken Burger, and We're Both Revolted and Intrigued
articles.summary: Has capitalism gone too far? KFC China has just revealed the Oreo Original Recipe Chicken Burger, and we can't help but be intrigued.
articles.body:
If you're a fan of strange and unholy fast food concoctions, then you'll definitely want to see what the crazed scienticians at KFC and Nabisco have concocted. Fresh off the reveal of their fried chicken-flavored Oreo cookies in China, the two companies have reversed that fusion to create the Oreo Original Recipe Chicken Burger.

This bizarre collab was revealed by KFC China on Weibo ( via Dexerto ). It looks every bit as strange as it sounds. The sandwich starts off ordinarily enough, with a fried chicken patty and lettuce, but it's topped with brown mashed potatoes dusted in cookie crumbles and placed between two Oreo cookie-flavored buns.

Like any good fast food mash-up, we can't decide if we're grossed out by this creation or deeply intrigued. Either way, American foodies shouldn't count on being able to try the Oreo Original Recipe Chicken Burger anytime soon. The sandwich is currently limited to the Chinese market only, with no indication of when or if it might come to the US.

Will you devour an Oreo Chicken Sandwich if given the opportunity? Cast your vote in our poll below:

This is just the latest odd creation from the folks at Nabisco. Past Oreo cookie variants have included Post Malone Oreos , which featured swirled salted caramel and shortbread flavored cream squeezed between one golden and one chocolate Oreo wafer cookie, and Mario Oreos . And in perhaps the most unholy combination of them all, there's the Ritz Oreo .

Jesse is a mild-mannered staff writer for IGN. Allow him to lend a machete to your intellectual thicket by following @jschedeen on BlueSky .

articles.title: Marvel Tokon Devs Confess Regaining Trust After Fumbled PC Launch Will Be 'Extremely Challenging'
articles.summary: Arc System Works has apologized for Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls' PC launch and admitted it will be "extremely difficult" to regain player trust.
articles.body:
Arc System Works has apologized for the troubled PC launch of Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls , and admitted it will now be "extremely difficult" to regain player trust.

Producer Takeshi Yamanaka offered a post-mortem on the release of the studio's new superhero fighting game during an interview with VGC . He noted that, when it comes to the content itself, fans have mostly nice things to say about Marvel Tokon, but the positivity isn't being shared by users across all platforms.

"They’re playing matches every day, they’re in training mode, they’re coming up with new combos, and we see them posting those on social media," Yamanaka said. "However, at the same time, unfortunately, in the PC version of the game, there have been in-game issues experienced by many players, which we really apologise to the player base for all of these problems."

Marvel Tokon brought tag-team gameplay to PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S August 6, 2026. While reviewers largely lobbed high scores its way (IGN gave it a 9/10 ), those on PC instead took to Steam to leave reviews of their own.

Arc System Works' new fighting game plummeted to "Mixed" reviews in all languages less than 24 hours after launch as players reported stuttering issues and forced PlayStation sign-in requirements. The weekend following its release on PC was only plagued by more negativity as the problems persisted, with the only message from the studio at the time being its promise to "investigate" reports of "performance issues." The state of Marvel Tokon on PC reportedly was so bad that even famed fighting game community content creator Maximilian Christiansen (a.k.a. Maximilian Dood) uninstalled the game in front of thousands of livestream viewers .

Arc System Works was able to speedily push out an update the following Monday, fixing many of the performance issues players had reported. But while Steam reviews have slightly rebounded, it's clear there's a long road ahead not only for Marvel Tokon but for the studio itself.

Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls Knights of Doom State of Play June 2026 Reveal Trailer - Screenshots

Yamanaka said "the team is hard at work to continue working on resolving remaining issues," noting two of the patches that have arrived since that early August release date. He also admitted that getting the Marvel fighting game in tip-top shape is only part of the battle.

"I do think that it's an extremely challenging task that we need to undertake," he said when asked about regaining trust, "where we sincerely want to put all of our effort forward to create an environment where the players can experience this game that we’ve worked so hard to create, and that we do have a lot of confidence that the game itself will be really fun for them."

Yamanaka again apologized for Marvel Tokon on PC after it "created a lot of trouble for the players." He and the rest of the team are hoping the community will stick around not only for those incoming fixes but more for the game itself, too.

"I would like to just say that I truly appreciate every single player who purchased the game around the launch," he added. "And to some players on the PC who were kind enough to purchase the game, but then they experienced these issues and were unable to play the game in its best way, and maybe left the game for the moment or even refunded. I would just like to express my sincere apologies for all of those issues that they’ve experienced.

"I do feel that it will not be an easy task at all to regain the trust that we've lost from this. However, this is an issue that we're facing head-on, and we’re trying to tackle it directly to try to continue working with all that we have and to provide an environment where players will be able to smoothly experience the game.

The Arc System Works producer continued, saying, "I feel that is the most that we can do." As additional updates are launched, he said, "all we can do is do our best and pray that that sentiment will reach the player base."

Either way, Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls is just getting started. DLC content is confirmed to be in the works, with Phoenix Cyclops already announced as a playable character set to join the roster this fall. Dataminers uncovered five more potential fighters earlier this month .

articles.title: RoboCop TV Show Casts Dan Stevens as Its Star
articles.summary: Prime Video's RoboCop TV show has reportedly cast Dan Stevens as its star.
articles.body:
UPDATE AUGUST 25, 2026: RoboCop star Dan Stevens has confirmed he's joined the Prime Video show with a social media post.

Stevens took to Instagram to share a video about the announcement, confirming his involvement. He didn't have much to add, but judging by the action figure behind him, it's safe to say he's excited.

"Buzz buzz..." he said. "Dead or alive, you're coming with me."

ORIGINAL STORY: Prime Video's RoboCop TV show has reportedly cast Dan Stevens as its star.

The Downton Abbey star has officially boarded the untitled RoboCop reboot series, according to Deadline . Stevens will play a new version of the cop-turned-robot, Alex Murphy.

Amazon MGM reportedly had its eye on Stevens early in the casting process. While he might be best known as Matthew Crawley, he's also appeared in projects like The Guest, the live-action Beauty and the Beast, the animated Among Us series, and more. The original Alex Murphy was played by Peter Weller, who returned to reprise the role across many RoboCop sequels and spinoffs.

Here's the official logline for the show: "A giant tech conglomerate convinces the city to place a powerful robot on its police force — a robot implanted with the consciousness of a beloved, fallen officer."

Amazon greenlit its Prime Video RoboCop revival in July, though it's said to have been in some form of development since the company acquired MGM back in 2022. Peter Ocko (Moonhaven, Lodge 49) is attached as showrunner, writer, and co-executive producer.

Blumhouse Atomic Monster's Michael Clear, Rob Hackett, and The Conjuring's James Wan are all involved as executive producers, too, with Danielle Bozzone overseeing for the company. Original RoboCop writers Ed Neumeier and Michael Miner are also executive producers.

"What Paul Verhoeven created in 1987 was decades ahead of its time, and its questions about technology, identity, and who corporations really serve have only grown more urgent,” Wan said in July. "With Peter’s distinctive vision and bold approach to storytelling, and alongside Ed and our partners at Amazon MGM Studios, we’re working to honor what made the original iconic and highlight its relevancy in this modern, tech-driven world, while building something unmistakably new for a global audience."

Outside of that aforementioned logline and the promise to deliver an eight-episode series, we know little about how RoboCop will revitalize an '80s action icon for modern audiences. Although it's without a firm release date or even any sort of window to look forward to, picking up Stevens just one month after the greenlighting process suggests the ball is rolling fast for now.

For more, you can read IGN's review for the RoboCop Criterion Collection release . You can also check out what we thought of the character's latest video game in our RoboCop: Rogue City review .

Outside of that aforementioned logline and the promise to deliver an eight-episode series, we know little about how RoboCop will revitalize an '80s action icon for modern audiences. Although it's without a firm release date or even any sort of window to look forward to, picking up Stevens just one month after the greenlighting process suggests the ball is rolling fast for now.
For more, you can read IGN's review for the RoboCop Criterion Collection release . You can also check out what we thought of the character's latest video game in our RoboCop: Rogue City review .

articles.title: Fans Pay Tribute to Dolly Parton After Country Music Legend Dies at 80
articles.summary: Country music icon, actress, and philanthropist Dolly Parton has died at 80 years old.
articles.body:
Country music icon, actress, and philanthropist Dolly Parton has died at 80 years old.

Her death was confirmed in a statement published by her family to Dolly’s official Instagram account on August 25, 2026.

“A rhinestone life that shone bright enough for the world to see, Dolly will forever stand as an inspiration not only through her timeless music and prolific songwriting, but also her wit, warmth, and kindness that made us all feel like family. Dolly Parton’s legacy is one of love, compassion, and resilience. With a seven-decade career, she inspired multiple generations of artists and fans with her music and an unwavering commitment to making the world a better place. Her songs will continue to resonate with people of all ages, and her philanthropic work will have a lasting impact,” her family said in a press release.

A small, private memorial service will be held for Dolly’s immediate family. Fans and friends are encouraged to remember her with posts on social media or by leaving a message on her official website.

In lieu of flowers, Dolly’s family encourages fans to make donations to the singer’s Imagination Library , a program that mails free books to children from birth until they begin school in participating areas.

Dolly had been public with her physical health struggles over the last few months. Just three days ago, she spoke with PEOPLE , saying she had been "dealing with some health issues" that she "just didn't pay attention to" while she was caring for her late husband, Carl Thomas Dean.

“It’s not like I haven’t been through hard times with my health,” Parton told the outlet. "But I think because we live in a 24/7 world with social media, everything gets magnified in ways it wasn’t years ago. I used to joke that I was the Queen of the Tabloids, but now I guess I can say I’m the Queen of Social Media AI! Seriously, though, even though I’m still healin’, I’m still workin’.”

And in May, Dolly gave fans a health update in a video on her Instagram account, saying she was "responding really well to meds and treatments" and was "improving every day."

It's difficult to overstate Dolly's impact on the world. She first debuted on The Cas Walker Show in 1956 at just ten years old, going on to be an icon of the 60s and 70s with a sparkling discography that carried on well into the 80s, 90s, and 2000s.

Aside from her prolific music career, Dolly was also an actress, best known for her 1980 comedy 9 to 5 and, of course, her role as Miley Cyrus' fictional godmother in Disney's Hannah Montana sitcom.

Parton was a philanthropist through and through; on top of her Imagination Library program, she also ran The Dollywood Foundation , a non-profit organization that offers academic scholarships, community aid, and disaster relief.

Dolly Parton was an icon and an inspirational figure to many, and her life served as a shining example of how we should live and conduct ourselves. May we all be as kind, generous, and gentle as Miss Dolly.

Virginia (she/her) is IGN’s News Editor. With ten years of experience reporting on games and entertainment, she’s got a storied background in the fighting game community, influencer news, and viral online trends. Find her on Twitter at @TheeMissGlaze .

articles.title: Tides of Annihilation Trailer Confirms Resident Evil Requiem Actress Angela Sant'Albano as New Voice of Gwendolyn
articles.summary: Tides of Annihilation has confirmed Resident Evil Requiem actress Angela Sant'Albano as the new voice of Gwendolyn.
articles.body:
Tides of Annihilation has confirmed Resident Evil Requiem actress Angela Sant'Albano as the new voice of Gwendolyn.

Eclipse Glow Games announced the news at gamescom Opening Night Live (ONL) 2026. It came with a new trailer for the highly anticipated Arthurian action-RPG, giving Tides of Annihilation fans a taste of Sant'Albano's new take on Gwendolyn.

"In the trailer, a distraught Gwendolyn considers her new reality amidst the ash of a ruinous London before being encouraged by the legendary Guinevere to harness the power of the Fog - a power only King Arthur once wielded - to save both London and the otherworldly realm of Avalon from total annihilation," an official description said. "Embracing her destiny, Gwendolyn takes up the sword and learns to fight alongside powerful spectral knights; this new trailer debuts the legendary Sir Lancelot summoned by Gwendolyn to dispatch enemies in spectacular style."

Sant'Albano is a star with a resume that includes parts in The Nevers, and Disney's live-action Dumbo movie, but the gaming world is still celebrating her for the part she played in Resident Evil Requiem. She showed up in Capcom's ninth mainline installment as Grace Ashcroft, a newcomer to the series with a shaky voice and deadly aim.

Despite half of the last Resident Evil being carried by fan-favorite zombie-slayer Leon S. Kennedy, Sant'Albano helped Grace emerge as yet another one of the series' memorable characters. Now, she's officially set to help do the same for Tides of Annihilation.

"I am beyond thrilled—and deeply honored—to officially announce that I’m stepping into the role of Gwendolyn in Tides of Annihilation," Sant'Albano said in a statement. "Gwen is the kind of heroine I love. She carries self-doubt, constantly questioning whether she's enough, but she refuses to let fear make her stand still. Everything she does is driven by love for her sister and her homeland, and I think that's what makes her strength feel so human. Getting to step into her boots, facing otherworldly demigods, and commanding Knights of the Round Table has been an absolute privilege."

Sant'Albano is officially joining the cast of another game that has players excited, but her part may not come as a shock to those who have kept up with all of the updates. When former Gwendolyn actress Jennifer English announced she would be stepping away from the role due to health concerns, rumors about who would take her place immediately began to spread.

The Resident Evil Requiem star was one of the first names to spread among fans. When some fans noticed some character models had seemingly been changed , rumors only heated up.

Eclipse Glow has also announced Tides of Annihilation will support Brazilian Portuguese when it eventually launches. That brings its supported languages up to 11, including English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Japanese, Chinese Simplified, Chinese Traditional, Korean, Russian. Additionally, gamescom attendees have been told that they'll be able to enjoy a hands-on demo.

Tides of Annihilation currently has no release date but is expected to launch for PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S. IGN previewed the game last week and walked away impressed by its combat but hoping for some movement tweaks. While we wait for additional updates, you can check out everything announced at gamescom ONL 2026 .

articles.title: Cyberpunk 2077 Commodore Computer Premieres at Gamescom, and It's Up for Preorder Now
articles.summary: The retro-futurism of Cyberpunk 2077 meets the retro computerism of the modern Commodore 64.
articles.body:
When I reviewed the Commodore 64 Ultimate, I honestly couldn't believe just how perfect it was. It surprised me in ways I didn't expect, and it's truly the result of a love and respect for the brand. It's why I gave the C64 Ultimate a 10 in my review . It's a thing of beauty, and now Commodore has officially unveiled a gorgeous new update in collaboration with CD Projekt Red: The Commodore 77.

The case itself is gorgeous, with the plate on the function keys now made of brushed metal. That's not a "brushed metal" finish, by the way: it's actually brushed metal. The rest of the case has been colored to match the Cyberpunk style, the Commodore 64 badge has been replaced with a Commodore 77 badge, and there are other changes that have to be seen to really be appreciated. The entire case has a weathered, suitably cyberpunk look to it, but just like with humans, it's what's inside that counts.

Aside from the new look, the Commodore 77 can now run at a blistering 77Mhz, compared to the 1Mhz of the original Commodore 64. There's also 77MB of system RAM compared to the original Ultimate's 16MB. While this new speed and power is pretty impressive (for the 1980s), it does run the risk of making some of your hand-written programs run impossibly fast, but you can toggle the higher speed off and on in the menus.

Hey, speaking of menus, the C77 also has a "custom Cyberpunk 2077 themed Commodore 77 BASIC 2.0 boot screen", which continues the overall Cyberpunk feel. The famous spiral-bound manual that's shipped with each Commodore 64 has also gotten a Cyberpunk facelift, and comes "packed with lore and exclusive Cyberpunk 2077-themed type-in BASIC programs." It's exactly the kind of thing old heads like me crave.

Each Commodore 77 ships with a shard-inspired Arasaka cartridge containing a demo created by Polish demo group Arise, with the soundtrack composed by chiptune artist LukHash. This is an old-school computer demo, the sort of thing hackers used to distribute to show off their chops. I've seen it. It's incredible. It's hard to believe what people can do with such limited computational power, but the soundtrack benefits enormously from the 24-track stereo SID chip that's part of the Ultimate.

Given how well Commodore did with its modern debut, I have no doubt in my mind the C77 is going to be similarly awesome, especially given the pedigree of its collaboration. Did I mention it comes with stickers and pins and in "collectible themed packaging?"

Oh, and it has LED lights that dance to the music on the demo. It's kind of everything I didn't even know I wanted.

Preorders are live at Commodore's website for $377, with an expected release date sometime next year. I, for one, welcome our CyberPunk and Commodore retro future.

Seth Macy is Senior Social Commerce Producer, and just wants to be your friend. You can find him on social media sites @SethFromMaine.
